7618.title: macOS desktop blanking and model catalog refresh
7618.rootCauseOneLine: The macOS blanking cause remains unknown; a six-second refresh retains cached models, and discovery crosses child-process and host-RPC boundaries.
7618.proposedFix: Capture PID-qualified macOS Electron main/renderer/GPU profiles and remount/navigation events before proposing a production change.
7618.caveats: Linux-only negative diagnostic; no macOS Electron UI, native trust faults, actual ACP provider, or visual blanking reproduced. Full test patch and output are inline in the HTML.
